description: Read your profile, creative-credit balance, and in-flight generations; update your profile. No account yet? Start with register (or login) — the returned session token is adopted automatically and every later call runs as that user. Actions: register, login, me, credits, activeGenerations, updateProfile. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
name: adgpt_account
title: AdGPT account
